description: This file defines the KeyWords class responsible for mapping symbols to their string representations and vice versa within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.IO namespace. It includes static initializations for these mappings, providing lookup methods for symbol name conversions.

classes.name: KeyWords
classes.description: A utility class for mapping between Symbol enum values and string representations used in document object serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: SymbolFromName
methods.description: Returns Symbol enum value corresponding to the given string name, or Symbol.None if not found.

methods.name: NameFromSymbol
methods.description: Returns the string representation associated with a given Symbol enum value.
